_comment: Two violations the policy must refuse. Case 1 is the reversion the founder predicted: a session writes a fresh Python guard instead of a Rego rule. Case 2 (laws-link-guard, since scope-guard moved to Rego in crew#603 CP5) is the quieter version: nobody adds a file, somebody just grows an existing one. Case 3 is the reversion the line ceiling cannot see: the file did not grow, it grew three more refusals. Case 4 is a Python file under policy/, which is where the last one actually lived. Case 5 is the wiring that landed without its file: a hook pointed at a script that is on a branch and not in the tree, which makes python3 exit 2 on every matching call, reads included. Case 6 is a test suite that grew more literal count assertions (founder 2026-08-28).
